messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up — HelmTech asked for a temporary QPS increase + EU allowlist for a customer demo on Thurs 17:00 CET. Renewal conversation in ~2 weeks; they want the demo to be rock-solid. Requesting a 48h window and auto-revoke after demo.

kai_support: Thanks — can you share target QPS and the client source IPs?

maria_cs: Target: 120 QPS sustained for the demo, ability to handle bursts up to 250 QPS for ~5–10m. IPs: 45.33.12.0/24 and 2.7.88.91. Prefer per-tenant override rather than global uplift.

jules_se: We can do a per-tenant override + pin them to eu-central model to hit latency. Will need a ticket for eng-infra to apply change. Any SLA/latency expectations?

sam_sales: :thumbsup: They're asking for median <100ms during demo. I'll be on the call. If we route EU-only and pin model, should be achievable.

ops_bot: INC-4892 created for helmtech-eu-demo-allowlist-qps; assignee: eng-infra oncall.

kai_support: Ops — proposed config snippet below, please review.

```
allowlist:
  tenant: helmtech
  ips: ["45.33.12.0/24", "2.7.88.91"]
qps_override:
  tenant: helmtech
  window_seconds: 172800
  soft_qps: 120
  burst_qps: 250
region: eu-central
```

jules_se: That looks good. I can push the canary policy/rollout 30m before the demo and watch regressions. Need eng-infra confirmation on autoscaler headroom. Also recommend structured logging for demo traces.

maria_cs: Please enable auto-revoke at 48h and tag the change with the renewal customer flag so AMs get a perf summary.

sam_sales: I'll capture screenshots and callouts during the demo for the renewal packet. Any risk to other tenants?

jules_se: With per-tenant override + model pin, other tenants unaffected. Only caveat: if autoscaler is saturated we could see slower scale-up — eng-infra to confirm spare capacity.

leo_oncall: leo_oncall (eng-infra): Oncall here — confirming eu-central has capacity headroom. I'll apply the allowlist and QPS override now as a canary, monitor metrics, and set an automated revoke at t+48h.

maria_cs: Thanks — please ping when applied.

ops_bot: Change applied at 1717810200 by leo_oncall. Monitoring dashboard: https://console.redwood.internal/dashboards/INC-4892 (internal link)

leo_oncall: :white_check_mark: Done. Verified CPU/GPU headroom and observed tail latency baseline. I'll keep an eye on token throughput and alert on >10% deviation. Will revert at 1717973000 unless we extend.

sam_sales: Great — noted. Maria, I'll attach perf screenshots and a short writeup to the renewal CRM entry.

maria_cs: Perfect — demo owners looped in. Thanks everyone :pray:
